name: C-hatchling-t2i-s113
prompt: A creature design: a newborn floating creature shaped like a wide flat cushion, about twice as wide as tall, hovering in the air; very wide-set eyes near the outer edges of its broad face; two small wing-like side fins; a tiny tail; no legs. Signature features: very wide-set eyes in a broad flat face, and wing-like side fins. Flat 2D character concept art for a calm, friendly health app. Style rules: flat filled shapes with no outlines and no line art; two-tone cel shading only with light from the upper left: every body part has its base color plus one slightly darker flat shade on its right side, and one small flat highlight at the upper left; no gradients, no texture, no 3D rendering. Palette: body warm apricot yellow (#FFC56E), belly and inner surfaces light cream (#FFEBC4), round blush cheeks coral (#F48C73), small simple eyes and mouth very dark teal-black (#1D3332) with one tiny white highlight dot in each eye; small accent areas may use lagoon turquoise (#3FB7D0), leaf green (#5FA44A) or sand (#F3D9A4). Soft, rounded, friendly forms; no teeth, no claws, no sharp spikes. Playful in the details, but calm, graceful and grown-up overall, not babyish and not a plush toy. One single creature, full body, centered with generous margin, three-quarter front view, on a plain flat pale mint background (#DDF0EE), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame.
